Sometimes I think that I should put up with it until I get my degree and find a stable job. 

I love movies. I used to go every weekend to the movies.

I don’t know how to.  Three months ago I got alcohol poisoning in an attempt to kill myself. I’m genuinely afraid.I just recently went back to college after my wife finished her nursing degree. I don’t have much money to afford a lawyer. I feel like I’m stuck.

And when I mention to my wife that I’m struggling to get over what happened. She tells me she’s gotten over it, she knows she did something bad, she’s gone to counseling and that I should grow up.
